namespace.description: The addon's namespace. It prefixes every screen's JSON UI namespace as <namespace>_<name>, so an addon's UI carries its own name and never collides with another addon's. Left unset, it is read from the creator/pack in core.register(), the way the other filters resolve it.

stamp.description: Draw a build stamp at the HUD's top-left — a short hash of every compiled screen plus the build clock — so a running client shows which build it is rendering.

screens.description: Modules whose default export is a record of screens to compile besides the addon's own *.screen.tsx files — a library's generic screens. The bedrock-core apps are added from the register call and need no entry here. Each export key names the screen.

pretty.description: How generated JSON is laid out. Absent or false writes it minified. An object lays it out: `indent` is "tab" or "space" (spaces when omitted), `size` the characters per level (2 for spaces, 1 for tabs when omitted).
